scenes.title: The Big Gap
scenes.body: The little squirrel wanted to reach the old oak tree, but the gap between the branches looked very big. It held onto its branch tightly and whispered, 'I can't.'
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: A Tiny Hop
scenes.body: A gentle voice from the oak tree called out, 'Try a tiny hop first.' A bigger squirrel showed how to take a small, safe jump. 'You can do it, one step at a time.'
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: The Brave Leap
scenes.body: The little squirrel squeezed its eyes shut, then opened them and took a deep breath. It gave a little jump and landed right on the next branch. 'I did it!' it cheered.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: Helping Others
scenes.body: Soon the little squirrel was leaping from branch to branch, gathering shiny acorns. It even helped a smaller squirrel cross the same gap. 'Being brave means trying, even when you feel scared,' it said. And that was the best lesson of all.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about courage.
